title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section I – European Parliament
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘and how target groups can be reached effectively, identifying best practices, and adapting the future development of the Europa Experience centres to local needs and demonstrated impact;’ and ‘in further expansion, ensuring that all future investments are more efficient in serving their intended purpose of bringing Parliament closer to citizens and improving their understanding of the Union’s democratic process;’
